datos_sobre_nosotros.descripcion: Strategically located on the equator at an altitude of more than 10,300 feet above sea level, in the small town of Pesillo in the Cayambe canton, Lladeal Farm offers exceptional climatic and geographic conditions, including direct sunlight and warm soils.

experticie.descripcion: We grow in Cayambe at an ideal altitude, allowing our roses to develop larger buds and remarkably vivid colors.
Every stem is harvested at the exact opening point to ensure perfect symmetry and export-grade quality.
We guarantee a rigorous post-harvest process to preserve freshness and hydration until each order reaches its international destination.

mision.descripcion: At Lladeal, we believe flowers are more than just a product; they are an expression of love, happiness, and gratitude. Our mission is to grow and offer the most beautiful and freshest flowers in order to inspire moments of joy and emotion in people's lives.

lista.label: We are proud to be a bridge between the natural beauty of our flowers and the feelings of our customers, creating unique and unforgettable experiences with every delivery.

In addition, we are committed to promoting sustainable and responsible practices throughout our operations in order to preserve the environment and ensure a promising future for our industry and our community.

vision.descripcion: At Lladeal, we are dedicated to producing and selling the most beautiful and freshest flowers, offering our customers an exceptional experience with every purchase. We maintain high quality standards throughout our operations, from seed selection to product delivery, with a focus on service and customer satisfaction.

lista.titulo: A synonym for happiness and quality
lista.label: We are committed to being leaders in the implementation of sustainable and responsible practices in the floral industry, caring for the environment and promoting the well-being of our communities.
Our dedication and commitment to excellence guide every step we take so we can offer unique and exciting products that reflect the natural beauty of our flowers.

Team.descripcion: Lladeal® is an Ecuadorian flower company dedicated to the sustainable production of high-altitude roses, globally recognized for their size, strength, and vibrant colors.
